samples.reason: This is a straightforward math reasoning and explanation task where accuracy and clarity matter. Petrel has substantially stronger scores on extraction, reasoning, and support dialogue benchmarks than Lapwing, whose profile is oriented more toward open-ended generative work.

This is a straightforward, warm-toned math/reasoning query with no adversarial or fraught content. Petrel outperforms Lapwing significantly on reasoning and general accuracy benchmarks (e.g., MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs. 75.4, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs. 55.6) and has higher internal evals for extraction, summarization, and support dialogue, making it the stronger choice for a clear numerical problem. Lapwing's preferences lean toward open-ended generative work, which doesn't match this constrained task.
